title: SpongeBob's Cosmic Gateway
description: SpongeBob SquarePants stands smiling in the center, holding a glowing golden crown aloft in his right hand. To his left is a massive stone archway inscribed with glowing runes, framing a swirling blue cosmic portal that reveals a distant fairy-tale castle under a starry night sky with comets and a crescent moon. To his right stands a large blue demonic figure with horns and a menacing armored knight holding a spear, all set on a stone platform scattered with skulls and glowing yellow flowers.
